images.lifetime: Startup-loaded shared slot; selector at ROM 0x33C94 later restores it when the captured requested state is 2 and the reread state is not 2. State meaning and complete lifetime remain unknown.

images.lifetime: Replacement in the shared slot, including when the selector rereads state 2. The transfer is observed at ROM 0x2BEEC and 0x33D70; state meaning and full lifetime remain unknown.
unknowns: Selector state at RAM 0x80169A44 has no established game-mode meaning.
Only full-window binary storage linkage is supported; C attribution remains unsupported.

components.note: Task descriptors establish storage pointer and 0xD0 size; the resident SP loader transfers it to IMEM. This is an RSP component inside main storage, not a second CPU image.

load_windows.note: IPL3 uses the header entrypoint, cartridge source B0001000 and PI length 0xFFFFF. A temporary 1 MiB copy is not unique image ownership.

unknown_rom_ranges.note: Unmapped stored tail. More CPU images, overlays, compressed data and assets may occur here; Yay0-like signatures such as 0x240C20 do not establish complete extents.

evidence.claim: Entry clear starts at RAM 0x80039000 with size 0x83C0, then jumps to RAM 0x80025C60; header establishes entry RAM 0x80025C00.
ROM 0x113C-0x1150 establishes RAM 0x801609B0 and end 0x801E4EA0, calling the clear helper with their difference 0x844F0.
ROM 0x1154-0x1170 supplies source ROM 0x14400, RAM 0x800413C0 and source end 0x1339F0; transfer size is 0x11F5F0.
ROM 0x1174-0x1190 supplies source ROM 0x1339F0, RAM 0x801E4EA0 and end 0x136DC0; transfer size is 0x33D0.
Selected prefix of zeroing helper at RAM 0x800265E0. This evidence span is not a complete function-boundary claim.
ROM 0x2BEEC-0x2BF08 supplies source ROM 0x136DC0, RAM 0x801E4EA0 and end 0x148460 (LUI 0x15 plus signed ADDIU 0x8460); transfer size is 0x116A0.

Selector starts at ROM 0x33C94; captures a0 at 0x33CA4, rereads RAM 0x80169A44 at 0x33D5C-0x33D68, transfers at 0x33D70-0x33DB4, and stores requested state at 0x33DB8-0x33DBC. Both ROM identities share the destination slot.
Task construction at ROM 0x25E1C-0x25E70 supplies RSP bootstrap pointer RAM 0x80136A10 and endpoint RAM 0x80136AE0.
Task construction at ROM 0x3DFAC-0x3E020 supplies the same RSP bootstrap storage pointer and size.
ROM 0x1004FC-0x100514 stores pointer RAM 0x80136A10 and endpoint-minus-pointer size 0xD0 in a task descriptor.
Resident SP loader reads task bootstrap pointer/length at ROM 0xDE6C-0xDE70 and calls the transfer to IMEM 0x04001000 at 0xDE74-0xDE7C.
CPU return at ROM 0x109A40, delay slot 0x109A44 and padding precede the RSP blob; this supports a provisional traversal endpoint only.
ROM 0x4C0-0x510 reads entrypoint from header, selects cartridge source B0001000 and PI length 0xFFFFF for a temporary 1 MiB copy.
